piano.source: Twenty authored scores in piano-song-data.js. Verse and Chorus repeat the same two-bar melody and chord progression three times, followed by a two-bar answer and tonic cadence; Intro and Bridge repeat twice. Bass, arpeggio voicing and percussion repeat with the hook. Runtime chart export and listening renderer are in scripts/music240.
piano.behavior: Visible notes sound immediately when their A/S/D/F lane is pressed. Short notes score on press; long notes require completing the hold. Early release retains partial progress while the note remains available. Independent lanes, one fresh press per note, top-entry countdown and foreground-stall protection remain. Short repeating figures establish each phrase before its answer and returning chorus.

effects.status: Existing procedural gameplay cues, recorded victory stages, gate cues, recorded praise and Battle effects retained.

beacon.spiral: Four shapes enter automatically in a spiral with airy whoosh; no tap prompt.
beacon.fireworks: Merge and traveling bursts followed by four waves of six large fireworks spread over the full viewport.
beacon.beams: Four overlapping staggered launches restore districts independently.
beacon.lanterns: Continuous rise during docking, one-second hold and outgoing map slide.

presentation.preparation: Core art and the main menu gate startup. Other destinations prepare on selection before gameplay begins. Hidden-tab time does not expire shared image preparation deadlines.

adventure.behavior: All 100 Adventure levels use normal matching gameplay. All maps and worlds are accessible; earned completion, stars, XP and inventory remain factual. Separate Games retain Piano Flow, Shape Drop and Shape Slice.
